h1: Before you throw that mattress away, talk to us
intro: A landlord in Harold Wood thought he'd have to throw his mattress away. We took the spots out of it and he didn't have to replace it. We clean mattresses with the same professional grade machines and stain specific products we use on carpets.

understand.heading: The machine, the product and the person
paragraphs: A professional clean comes down to three things: a professional grade machine, the right product for each stain, and someone with the training and experience to use them.
Different stains need different products. Blood, coffee, oil and ink each need their own. Anyone doing professional carpet, mattress or upholstery cleaning should be carrying them, and we do.

proof.heading: A mattress the landlord was ready to throw away
proof.paragraph: In Harold Wood, the tenants had left a property in a horrible condition. The landlord told us he might need to throw away the mattress and change so many things in the flat. We took the spots out of the mattress, deep cleaned the carpets, the kitchen and the bathroom. He didn't have to replace anything, and the property was ready for new tenants.

faqs.question: How much does mattress cleaning cost?
faqs.answer: Mattress cleaning starts from £39, and you see your price before you book.

faqs.question: Is it worth cleaning a stained mattress instead of replacing it?
faqs.answer: It can be. In Harold Wood, a landlord thought he'd have to throw a mattress away. We took the spots out of it, and he didn't have to replace it.

faqs.question: What machines do you use?
faqs.answer: Professional grade machines only, the same ones we use for carpets and upholstery.

faqs.question: Can a home machine do the same job?
faqs.answer: Not for a professional deep clean. Home machines are fine for keeping things fresh, but a professional clean needs a professional grade machine.

faqs.question: What products do you use?
faqs.answer: Professional grade cleaning liquids, plus specific products for different kinds of stains.

faqs.question: Can you treat stains like blood, coffee, oil or ink?
faqs.answer: Each of those needs a different product, and we carry professional products for each of them.

faqs.question: Do you clean mattresses for landlords?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Harold Wood mattress was part of an end of tenancy clean for a landlord, and the property was ready for new tenants afterwards.

faqs.question: Does it matter who does the cleaning?
faqs.answer: Yes. A good machine is only part of it. Training and experience are what get the most out of the machine and the products, and tell us what can and can't be achieved.

faqs.question: Who will clean my mattress?
faqs.answer: Someone from our own trained, insured and DBS checked team. We never send random people.

faqs.question: Do you also clean carpets and upholstery?
faqs.answer: Yes, with the same professional machines and the same stain specific products.

faqs.question: What if I'm not happy with the clean?
faqs.answer: Tell us within 24 hours and we put it right.

faqs.question: What is your show up guarantee?
faqs.answer: We have systems in place so our cleaners arrive on the day and at the time you booked. If something outside our control happens, your clean is still done within 12 hours, or we do it for free.

faqs.question: What happens if something goes wrong on the day?
faqs.answer: We don't just cancel. We still handle your booking and get it done within 12 hours. If your clean was booked for the afternoon, for example, it would move to first thing the next morning.

faqs.question: How do you make sure your cleaners turn up?
faqs.answer: We check on our cleaners early in the morning and again late in the afternoon, so we know they're on track.

faqs.question: How long have you been cleaning?
faqs.answer: 12 years. I started as a cleaner myself, and SN Cleaning Services was registered in 2019.
